card.name: Word endings before a slash or bracket
card.fires_on: The last piece of a word that is about to be followed by a URL path, a section title, or a reference bracket. Seen in 'essays' in web addresses, 'Populations' in 'Use in Specific Populations (8.1)', and 'Age' in pediatric table headings.

modes.label: URL path pieces
modes.description: Word ending inside a web address, just before a slash and the next path part.

modes.label: Label section titles
modes.description: Final piece of 'Populations' in a cross-reference to a section, before a number in brackets.
modes.example: [see Use in Specific Pop<<ulations>> (8.1) , and Clinical

modes.label: Heading word endings
modes.description: Last piece of a heading or label word, such as medications, pharmacokinetics or Age, before the text continues.
modes.example: KEEP THIS AND ALL MEDICATION<<S>> OUT OF THE REACH OF CHILDREN

card.writes: Weak effect; it slightly favors markup-like pieces such as '</' and '**', and the rest is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on the last piece of a word right before a link path, a heading, or a section cross-reference continues.
